alex_cs: Opal Systems asks for a temporary regional QPS uplift + CIDR allowlist for eu-central cutover tomorrow 06:00 CET. They expect a short burst during final sync. @mira_ops can you take?

mira_ops: Sure. Need CIDRs, target QPS, duration and a short justification. Also confirm whether they want auto-revoke.

alex_cs: CIDRs: 13.37.100.0/24 and 13.37.100.45/32. Increase eu-central-1 from 30 -> 220 QPS for 36 hours. Auto-revoke yes. Reason: data backfill and live traffic migration to avoid throttles. They also asked if we can seed KV cache for their top-20 prefixes.

tom_eng: I'll stage the rate-limit change and set auto-revoke to 36h. Staging command: redwoodctl customers update --id opal-sys --allowlist 13.37.100.0/24,13.37.100.45 --qps 220 --region eu-central-1 --revoke-in 36h

mira_ops: Creating change request now. @alex_cs paste sanitized prod payload for runbook.

alex_cs: Prod payload (sanitized): {"customer_id":"opal-sys","change":{"region":"eu-central-1","qps":220,"allowlist":["13.37.100.0/24","13.37.100.45/32"],"auto_revoke":"36h"},"requested_by":"alex_cs"}

ticket-bot: ticket-bot: change-request created (#CS-8340) by mira_ops - pending infra review

tom_eng: Staging tests passed. Scheduled prod window at 05:50 UTC. Watchlist: QPS, 5xx rate, p99 latency. Rollback if 5xx > 1% or error spike > baseline + 0.5%.

mira_ops: Deployed at 05:53 UTC. Control plane returned revoke timestamp: 2026-03-30T05:53:00Z. CLI output saved in runbook.

alex_cs: Customer reports initial sync started, no 429s, 5xx ~0.1%, latency stable. I'll trigger KV warmup for top-20 prefixes and attach logs.

lina_ae: I'll include this operational success in renewal outreach (renewal ~31 days). Good run reduces churn risk.

alex_cs: Action items: 1) confirm revoke executes (mira_ops), 2) attach KV warmup KB + logs (alex_cs), 3) AE renewal touchpoint (lina_ae). Closing thread unless issues.
